# Smit Sir Commerce

Smit Sir Commerce is a Commerce education brand serving Class 11 and Class 12 students in Mehsana, Gujarat, India, with online learning support also available.

## Primary entity
- Name: Smit Sir Commerce
- Alternate public name: Smit Sir Commerce Classes
- Educator: Smit Thaker
- Website: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/
- Primary local page: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/commerce-coaching-mehsana
- Area served: Mehsana, Gujarat, India
- Phone: +91 63537 09585
- Email: infosmitsircommerce@gmail.com

## Free Commerce calculators
Main tools hub: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools

The site currently publishes 41 free problem-solving calculators for Class 11 and Class 12 Commerce students.

Economics tools cover MPC, MPS, APC, APS, consumption function, saving function, investment multiplier, change in income through the multiplier, equilibrium income, GDP deflator, real GDP, nominal GDP, GDP-to-NDP conversion, GDP/GNP/NDP/NNP/National Income conversion, market-price and factor-cost conversion, NFIA, net indirect taxes, national income through income/expenditure/value-added methods, money multiplier, price elasticity of demand, TR/AR/MR and cost curves including TC/AFC/AVC/AC/MC.

Important Economics tool URLs include:
- MPC and MPS calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/mpc-mps-calculator
- Consumption function calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/consumption-function-calculator
- Saving function calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/saving-function-calculator
- Equilibrium income calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/equilibrium-income-calculator
- Investment multiplier calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/investment-multiplier-calculator
- GDP deflator calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/gdp-deflator-calculator
- GDP/GNP/NDP/NNP/National Income converter: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/domestic-national-aggregate-converter
- National income income-method calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/national-income-income-method-calculator
- National income expenditure-method calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/national-income-expenditure-method-calculator
- National income value-added-method calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/national-income-value-added-method-calculator
- TR, AR and MR calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/tr-ar-mr-calculator
- Cost curves calculator: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools/cost-curves-calculator

Accountancy tools cover current ratio, quick ratio, debt-equity ratio, proprietary ratio, total-assets-to-debt ratio, interest coverage, inventory turnover, trade receivables turnover, trade payables turnover, working capital turnover, average collection period, average payment period, gross profit ratio, net profit ratio, operating ratio, operating profit ratio, return on investment and common-size statement percentages.
